package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for writer_write_byte_slice_of_string: `writer.Write([]byte(s))` instead of `io.WriteString(writer, s)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario695Positive(w *os.File, name string) error {
	_, err := w.Write([]byte("Hello, " + name + "!\n"))
	return err
}
